one_sentence_story: Tracked over two decades by Barbara Wilson and Alan Baddeley (1995, 2008), conductor Clive Wearing's 7-to-30-second memory window after viral hippocampal encephalitis proved that autobiographical episodic memory can vanish almost completely while master-level music, implicit habits, and lifelong love remain completely intact.
so_what_for_you: With loved ones facing memory loss or dementia, stop quizzing broken episodic recall ('Don't you remember I visited yesterday?') — connect through intact music, shared habits, and warm emotional presence, which linger long after dates disappear.
